newsitem.title: USA: Med Industries says group overstates stake.
newsitem.headline: Med Industries says group overstates stake.

text.p: Medical Industries of America Inc said certain holders of its series D convertible preferred stock are overstating their post- conversion ownership of the company's common stock on a regulatory filing.
In a statement issued Friday, the company said the error appeared to be in the shareholders' application of the formula to convert the preferred shares into common stock.
Medical Industries said it has informed its legal counsel of the error and inquired whether the misleading filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission expose the company to any liability.
The company was not immediately available for further comment.
